# Storage Decision Note — Maple Records
**Date:** 20 July 2026

## Recommendation
Select **Option C** as the only currently feasible choice.

## Option Comparison
| Requirement | A | B | C |
|---|---|---|---|
| First-year cost | 11 units — **exceeds budget** | 8 units — **exceeds budget** | 8 units — **compliant** |
| Recovery time | 2 hours — compliant | 5 hours — **exceeds limit** | 3 hours — compliant |
| Location | On premises — compliant | On premises — compliant | On premises — compliant |
| Current capacity | 24 TB — compliant | 24 TB — compliant | 14 TB — compliant |

Options A and B each fail a hard requirement: A exceeds the 10-unit budget; B exceeds the 4-hour recovery limit (S1, S2). Option C satisfies all current constraints.

## Capacity Check Before Growth
Current storage is 12 TB. Forecasted 4 TB growth next year would reach 16 TB, exceeding C's 14 TB ceiling (S1). Before that growth materializes, verify C's expansion pricing and post-expansion recovery time—both currently unknown (S2).
